params.body:
The Observatory's design system was a guide (`BRAND.md`) and the colour tokens in `index.css`. Everything else was written by hand on each page, about 1,600 inline style objects over 28 pages, so each page decided its own buttons, pagers, fields and labels, and nothing said when one left the guide. On 2026-11-03 the pages held 78 raw hex colours, 68 middle dots, 23 em dashes, 46 uppercase labels and 141 buttons styled by hand. The Reports page showed what that costs: its failed reports had no retry, and a healthy row, a count and a pager each broke a rule of the guide.

## Decisions (BRAND.md, "Decided on 2026-11-03")
- Actions are aqua: `--color-cta` points at `brand`. Crimson is `hot` and destructive verbs only. The filled buttons on Accounts, Plans, model routing, the error page and sign-in turn aqua with it.
- Selected is an underline (nav, filters, pager). A pressed `Button` keeps its outline.
- No new spaced capitals; a label is a word in `txt-3` (`.label`).
- 6px controls, square containers.

## Components
`components/ui` already held `Button`. It now holds the other controls with states, each with its look once in `index.css`:
- `Input`, `Select`, `Textarea` (`.field`)
- `SearchField` (`.search`, says "n of m" while it narrows)
- `Filters` (`.filters`; Sources uses it now)
- `Pager` (`.pager`, words, the current page underlined)

The guide's ban on a `components/ui` folder is rewritten to what the code does: controls with states are components, containers stay inline.

## The brand ratchet
`bin/brand-ratchet.mjs`, in CI after the lint ratchet and as `npm run brand`. Per file it counts raw colours, middle dots, em dashes, uppercase labels and buttons without a class, in code not comments. Above `.brand-baseline.json` fails; below it, `--write` lowers the ceiling. Checked by adding one of each to a page: it fails on the three that apply and ignores a comment.

## Reports
- A failed report shows its reason and a retry in the failed list. The retry button existed only on reports that had been read, so a failed one never had it.
- A search by title, author or file (`SearchField`).
- Paging with `Pager`. A read report no longer has a green rule and its count is no longer coloured. "1 citation". No middle-dot chain.
- Works with pipeline #419, which lets the retry find a file named in "Uploaded:" notes.

## Tests
`e2e/reports-retry-search.spec.js` (reason, retry posts the id, search by author and by file). Full e2e suite: 95 passed. Build ok; lint ratchet down from 22 to 21 errors.
params.title: Design system: decisions, shared controls and a brand ratchet; Reports retry and search
